_comment: Which of Printify's mockups the site shows. Only real, photographic product shots: no flat 2D drawings, no models or faces, no blank or cropped frames. `studioOnly` lines show only their studio shots (assets-src/merch-studio/<slug>/, which need to exist for every color, or that color is left out). `hide` removes single mockups by key (regexes over merch/<slug>/<color>-N). Read by lib/merch.ts and scripts/build-share-images.mjs; the Printify sync still downloads everything.
